questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\left|\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}-1\right|=\begin{cases}\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}-1, & (x,y,z)\in \Omega_1\\1-\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}, & (x,y,z)\in \Omega_2\end{cases},\\&\text{其中}\;\Omega_1:\;\;1\leq x^2+y^2+z^2\leq 4\;,\;\;\Omega_2:\;\;0\leq x^2+y^2+z^2\leq 1\,;\\&\text{原式}=\iiint\limits_{\Omega}(\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}-1)dv+\iiint\limits_{\Omega_2}(1-\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2})dv\\&=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi}d\varphi\int_1^2(r-1)r^2\sin\varphi dr+\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi}d\varphi\int_0^1(1-r)r^2\sin\varphi dr\\&=4\pi\int_1^2(r^3-r^2)dr+4\pi\int_0^1(r^2-r^3)dr=\frac{17\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{3}=6\pi\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \Omega \text{是} x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\leq \pi^{2}\text{与} z\geq \sqrt{3x^{2}+3y^{2}}\text{围成闭区域，则三重积分} \iiint\limits_{\Omega}\sin(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}d v=[\quad].

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\Omega \text{即} \begin{cases} 0 \leq \theta \leq 2 \pi \\ 0 \leq \varphi \leq \pi \\ 1 \leq r \leq 2 \end{cases}, \\& \text{原式} = \iiint\limits_{\Omega} z^2 dv + \iiint\limits_{\Omega} z dv = \int_{0}^{2 \pi} d \theta \int_{0}^{\pi} d \varphi \int_{1}^{2} r^2 r^2 \cos^2 \varphi \cdot r^2 \sin \varphi dr + 0 \\& = 2 \pi \cdot \int_{0}^{\pi} \cos^2 \varphi \sin \varphi d \varphi \cdot \int_{1}^{2} r^4 dr = \frac{62}{5} \pi \left( \frac{- \cos^3 \varphi}{3} \right) \Bigg|_{0}^{\pi} = \frac{124}{15} \pi.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{若}\,\Omega:\ \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\leq z\leq \sqrt{2-x^{2}-y^{2}}\ ,\ \text{则}\iiint\limits_{\Omega}(x^{2}+z)d v=[\quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\Omega \text{即} & \begin{cases} 0 \leq \theta \leq 2\pi \\ 0 \leq \varphi \leq \frac{\pi}{4} \\ 0 \leq r \leq \sqrt{2} \end{cases}, \\\text{原式} & = \iiint_{\Omega} x^2 dv + \iiint_{\Omega} z dv = \frac{1}{2} \iiint_{\Omega} (x^2+y^2) dv + \iiint_{\Omega} z dv \\ & = \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} d\varphi \int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}} r^4 \sin^3 \varphi dr + \int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} d\varphi \int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}} r^3 \cos \varphi \sin \varphi dr \\ & = \frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5} \pi \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sin^3 \varphi d\varphi + 2\pi \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sin \varphi \cos \varphi d\varphi \\ & = \frac{4\sqrt{2}\pi}{5} \left( \frac{\cos^3 \varphi}{3} - \cos \varphi \right) \left| \frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{\pi}{2} \right| = \frac{16\sqrt{2}-5}{30}\pi \;.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{若} \Omega: \ \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\leq z\leq \sqrt{2-x^{2}-y^{2}}\ ,\ \text{则} \iiint\limits_{\Omega} y^{2}d v=[\quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\iiint\limits_{\Omega} y^{2}dv=\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}(r\sin\varphi\sin\theta)^{2}\cdot r^{2}\sin\varphi dr\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\sin^{2}\theta d\theta\cdot\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{3}\varphi d\varphi\cdot\int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}r^{4}dr=\pi\cdot\frac{8-5\sqrt{2}}{12}\cdot\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5}=\frac{8\sqrt{2}-10}{15}\pi..\\&\text{或者}\quad\iiint\limits_{\Omega} y^{2}dv=\frac{1}{2}\iiint\limits_{\Omega}(x^{2}+y^{2})dv\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}r^{4}\sin^{3}\varphi dr=\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5}\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{3}\varphi d\varphi=\frac{8\sqrt{2}-10}{15}\pi.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}\ \Omega \text{是} x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\leq z \text{与} x^{2}+y^{2}\leq z^{2} \text{确定的立体区域，则积分} I=\iiint\limits_{\Omega}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}\,dv=[\quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\Omega \text{在球面坐标系下为} \begin{cases} 0 \leq \theta \leq 2\pi \\ 0 \leq \varphi \leq \frac{\pi}{4} \\ 0 \leq r \leq \cos \varphi \end{cases}, \text{所以} \\&I = \int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} d\varphi \int_{0}^{\cos \varphi} r^{3} \sin \varphi dr = \frac{\pi}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sin \varphi \cos^{4} \varphi d\varphi = - \frac{\pi}{2} \cdot \frac{\cos^{5} \varphi}{5} \left| \frac{\pi}{4} \right|_{0} = \frac{\pi}{10} (1 - \frac{\sqrt{2}}{8}) .\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{当}\,\Omega \text{是}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\leq z\leq \sqrt{1-x^{2}-y^{2}}\ ,\ \text{则}\iiint\limits_{\Omega}z\cdot\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}\,dv=[\quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由}\begin{cases}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}=z\\z=\sqrt{1-x^{2}-y^{2}}\end{cases},\text{则}\begin{cases}x^{2}+y^{2}=\frac{1}{2}\\z=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{cases},\text{于是}\begin{cases}0\leq \theta\leq 2\pi\\0\leq \varphi\leq \frac{\pi}{4}\\0\leq r\leq 1\end{cases}\\&\text{原式}=\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_{0}^{1}r\cos\varphi r^{3}\sin\varphi dr=2\pi\cdot\frac{1}{5}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\varphi\cos\varphi d\varphi\\&=\frac{2\pi}{5}\frac{\sin^{2}\varphi}{2}\left|\frac{\pi}{4}\right|_{0}=\frac{\pi}{10}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{若}\,\Omega\text{是}x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\leq 1\text{时，则}\iiint\limits_{\Omega}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\,d\nu=[\quad].

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{原式} = \int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\varphi \int_{0}^{2\cos \varphi} r^{2} \sin^{2} \varphi \cdot r^{2} \sin \varphi dr = \frac{64\pi}{5} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^{3} \varphi \cdot \cos^{5} \varphi d\varphi \\& = \frac{64\pi}{5} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (\cos^{5} \varphi - \cos^{5} \varphi) d\cos \varphi = \frac{64\pi}{5} \cdot (\frac{\cos^{8} \varphi}{8} - \frac{\cos^{6} \varphi}{6}) \Bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} = \frac{8}{15} \pi \,.\end{aligned}
